activities.title: Format your Lab 3 inventory
activities.intro: Open your Lab3 Inventory file from Topic 3.1. Work through the checklist and tick each step as you finish it.

items: Check types: every Qty, Unit Cost and Reorder Level sits on the right of its cell.
Row 1: bold, centered, dark fill, white text. Wrap Text on Reorder Level.
Select D2:E9 and format as Currency ₱ with 2 decimals.
Select A1:F9 and add All Borders. AutoFit the columns.
Select C2:C9 and add a conditional formatting rule: =C2<=F2, light red fill.

blocks.prompt: How many Qty cells turned red?
Which items turned red? Pick all that apply.
Click D2. What does the formula bar show?
What formula did you type for the conditional formatting rule?
A screenshot of your formatted inventory

help: Currency shows a dollar sign? Press Ctrl+1 and pick the ₱ (Philippines) symbol.
The rule highlights the wrong rows? Your selection must start at C2 before you make the rule.
Every Qty cell is red? You typed =$C$2. Remove the $ signs. We explain $ in Topic 3.5.
Finished early? On a new sheet, format a Date Received column with today's date (Ctrl+;).

activities.title: Quick check: the total is too small

blocks.prompt: The Qty column looks fine, but its total is too small. Some quantities sit on the left of their cells. Why?
options: Those quantities are stored as text
